roleProbe.limitation: The authorized MCP SQL scope was SELECT-only, so transaction-local SET ROLE and claims were not attempted. Executable fixtures validate policy decisions without claiming a live role probe.

officialSources.finding: No current changelog item directly changed this hosted RLS or Storage contract.
